topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I thought I had something special, something that could change lives, perhaps even make the world a little better. I poured countless nights and weekends into this project, sketches spread across my table, ideas dancing in my head. I envisioned the day I would present it to the world, the applause, the recognition. But then, while digging through patent archives, I found it. My invention, or rather, what I thought was my invention, already claimed, already protected. The pages of the patent, cold and official, seemed to laugh at my naivety. Now, all that's left is the echo of the dreams I had, the faintest whisper of what could have been.
